Dear BerlinRosen Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Account Coordinator, Real Estate position in New York. With a B.A. in Communication from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, and experience in congressional communications, campaign content, and business advocacy, I would bring strong writing, research, and coordination skills to your team.

In Democratic Whip Katherine Clark’s office, I gather and distribute daily press clips and district news reporting for more than 50 members of Congress. I also prepare briefing memos and support front office operations, balancing detailed assignments with time-sensitive requests. This experience has trained me to track developments carefully, communicate concisely, and keep multiple responsibilities moving.

At the Tennessee Chamber of Commerce and Industry, I helped execute the organization’s first statewide infrastructure summit, bringing together government and business leaders. I also designed hundreds of Canva graphics and contributed to social media improvements that increased Instagram engagement by 8% and follower count by 64%. That work gave me experience supporting both public-facing content and events involving varied stakeholders.

In Congressman Josh Harder’s office, I produced social media copy, graphics, photo releases, constituent form letters, and briefing-style research. My contract research for CLT Public Relations covered more than 90 candidates across 24 municipal elections in 12 cities, requiring careful source review and organization.

I am interested in applying these skills to communications about development, infrastructure, and the communities affected by those decisions. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute dependable account support while building my real estate communications and media relations experience. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Evan Pryor
